decls.name: SublemmaArithmeticBound

paper_span.quote: Using \(|U| \ge e^{\gamma f}\) and the choice of \(R\) gives \(E_a \ge e^{\gamma f/2}N_a\).

decls.rationale: The closing arithmetic of Lemma 2.4: from \(|U| \ge e^{\gamma f}\) and \(\log\rho_R > -\gamma/2\) it derives \(|U|\rho_R^f \ge e^{\gamma f/2}\), turning the pigeonhole bound \(E_a \ge |U|\rho_R^f N_a\) into \(E_a \ge e^{\gamma f/2}N_a\).
